verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developers page says customers can "use our API directly to take full control of your workflow" alongside a Zapier integration, and its mailbox does produce online scans. That makes a first-party API plausible, but nothing shows it lists mail items or serves scan downloads, and no public API reference was found (OpenAPI/Swagger paths and llms.txt all return 404). missing for 10: documented endpoints for listing mail items, documented scan/PDF download endpoint, public API reference or OpenAPI spec, authentication docs, independent or hands-on confirmation of API use.
